version.approval_notes:
Build from source:

1. Node 20 (see .nvmrc).
2. npm ci
3. npm run build:firefox
4. The reviewable output is extension/firefox/dist/

The submitted zip is that directory, packaged with `web-ext build`.

Note: the background entry chunk filename (assets/background.ts-<hash>.js) embeds a content hash that varies with the absolute build path, so a rebuild in a different directory yields a different hash. manifest.json and service-worker-loader.js reference it consistently within any single build; all other chunk names are stable.

The extension talks only to a loopback MCP server the developer runs locally (127.0.0.1, localhost); it makes no other network requests.

release_notes.en-US: See CHANGELOG.md in the source archive.
